services.value: Provides environmental field and laboratory analytical testing services, including field services and contract services, inorganic testing and analysis, organic testing and analysis, waste characterization and analysis, and wet chemistry analysis. Inorganic capabilities include ICP-AES metals analysis and cold vapor mercury analysis, and organic capabilities include VOC/SVOC/BTEX and TPH analyses by specified EPA/SW-846 methods and GC/GC/MS.
